svg.title: Lab 10 — Catalog cache architecture
svg.desc: Customer and bounded load driver reach the public read-only Cloud Run Catalog service. An operator reaches a separate IAM-protected Cloud Run admin service. Both services in asia-southeast1 use Direct VPC egress through a dedicated subnet to Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Memorystore Redis private endpoints over Private Services Access. PostgreSQL is the source of truth and Redis is an authenticated TLS cache. Secret Manager supplies Redis AUTH and CA versions; Cloud Logging and Monitoring receive runtime logs and managed-service metrics.
svg.text: Catalog Cache — private data path, bounded read optimization
Public reads · IAM-protected writes · PostgreSQL source of truth · Redis is disposable cache
